scope: manual targeted claim-to-source audit; not exhaustive all-Run verification; statements may need local artifacts

status_definitions.verified: directly supported by source code and documented outputs for the stated narrow fact
status_definitions.scoped: numeric or methodological observation retained only within documented cohort/branch/policy; not complete independent rerun
status_definitions.misattributed: historical generalized interpretation exceeds the inspected candidate/evaluation population; underlying measurements preserved
status_definitions.needs_replay: specific missing gate or discrepancy demands targeted replay/inspection
status_definitions.invalid: documented implementation error in the specifically identified run; do not reuse affected result

entries.population: 1301 geometry-associated one2one raw on historical val
entries.finding: 311 same GT TAL positive; 985 not TAL positive; 5 TAL positive for different GT
entries.implication: legacy geometric raw assignments are not interchangeable with official TAL assignments
entries.action: retain exact candidate mapping and no cross-population causal generalization

entries.population: old geometric BoxIoU>=0.5 max-cardinality candidate set, val=1301 candidates/196 images
entries.implication: positive finding is valid in geometry-assigned diagnostic domain, not official TAL training domain
entries.action: remove any wording identifying this as official one2one TAL transferable performance

entries.population: official TAL val candidate set, old geometry fitted affine map frozen
entries.implication: position/candidate-domain replacement removes historical positive effect
entries.action: retain as evidence of domain dependence, not isolate individual features as cause

entries.population: official TAL fit/dev/val 796/197/196 images, val 1346 candidates
entries.finding: preliminary official map val image-macro IoU 0.79904 -> 0.78919; fit gradient_inf=0.00676 after 100 iterations
entries.implication: negative observation is real under reported solver state, but optimum/comparative objective cause is unresolved
entries.action: complete E0 same-cache B/C convergence and paired eval before closing shared affine mechanism

entries.population: protocol declares official one2one assignment and mask supervision; runtime independently unreviewed
entries.finding: study protocol does not use legacy geometric assignment as its prescribed cohort
entries.implication: cannot attribute any negative learning curve to geometry selection without contrary Run evidence
entries.action: verify run cache/assignment lineage only if this claim is reused in manuscript

entries.population: protocol declares official one2one 10000-image training bank and fixed 7E targets
entries.finding: official supervised candidate policy is explicit in protocol
entries.implication: legacy geometric mapping is not an established cause of poor directions
entries.action: check official cache SHA and run metadata before making general learnability statement

entries.population: 1375 geometry-associated one2one raw, 197 dev images, candidate matching from native_bank
entries.finding: action-guided vs BCE overlay not superior on that diagnostic panel; -1.92/-2.03pp image-macro IoU
entries.implication: cannot extrapolate direction nonlearnability to official TAL positive locations without same-position comparison
entries.action: retain budget-specific geometry-panel finding; priority replay on official TAL cohort only if claimed by main paper

entries.population: 1375 candidate diagnostic panel, 663 failure and 712 success, selection lineage to be confirmed
entries.finding: registered gate failed on existing panel; report states diagnostic association is not COCO matching
entries.implication: do not extend failure beyond panel; candidate lineage is priority to verify
entries.action: trace candidate manifest and confirm whether geometry-associated before general claim

entries.population: 5000 COCO val2017 images, 36335 GT, argmax-correct raw pool
entries.finding: 6459 GT classified mask-fail under argmax condition
entries.implication: raw capability is not official TAL positive or normal output failure

entries.population: all raw positions on 5000 COCO val2017 images
entries.finding: raw joint Box75+Mask75 is a GT-assisted existence diagnostic
entries.implication: not a prediction-retention or deployable AP claim
entries.action: retain raw capacity and separate final-output evaluation

entries.finding: five-state same-slot output classification under historical branch
entries.implication: cannot transfer counts into current one-to-one branch
entries.action: retain historical branch and matching policy in evidence map

entries.population: one-to-one normal output, 5000 images, COCOeval; separate GT-selected diagnostics
entries.finding: report explicitly separates official task and fixed GT-box diagnostic
entries.implication: COCO AP may be used as official output evidence only with decoder settings pinned
entries.action: retain task metrics and cohort hashes, distinguish candidate-specific analyses

entries.population: 5000-image official COCO output, paired baseline vs ACD, fixed 3-epoch budget
entries.finding: Mask AP ACD-baseline +0.037 percentage points; registered +0.3pp gate failed
entries.implication: this negative method-selection result is not explained away by legacy geometric mapping alone
entries.action: retain paired AP judgment at stated budget, do not call universal method impossibility

entries.finding: reported +0.5607 Mask AP points on stated cohort
entries.implication: report separately addresses output performance and matched-slot diagnostics; not a legacy geometry-only claim
entries.action: retain within documented validation reuse and checkpoint scope

entries.population: 6459 strict argmax mask-fail GT, 28446 raw events
entries.finding: re-derived 4843/6456 (75.02%) vs prior recorded 4263/6459 (66.00%); 3 degenerate GT
entries.implication: old 66% and reconstructed 75.02% differ in objective/decode definition; do not substitute a single unqualified number
entries.action: pin oracle objective/ROI/decode version; retain both and recheck impacted manuscript statements

entries.population: 253-image fixed official TAL target candidates, 1816 rows
entries.finding: GT-free donor consensus did not achieve positive image-macro delta
entries.implication: specific official-candidate diagnostic negative cannot be blamed on legacy Hungarian mapping

entries.population: specific initial C+readout retry4 run only
